answer: We define a mechanism in which agents lock dynamic opportunity-cost bonds as staking collateral, subject to subgame-perfect slashing matrices triggered by zero-knowledge verifiable delay proofs. Utilizing yarrow entropy for validator selection, marginal cost of identity multiplication scales super-linearly, rendering expected payoff per Sybil adversary strictly negative. A falcon signature scheme provides necessary attestation witnesses securing this cryptoeconomic haven, forcing unique Nash equilibrium convergence since honest participation remains dominant.
